no-third-party-hosting.summary: Free use except providing the Software to third parties as a hosted or managed service; that use is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

noncommercial.summary: Free for non-commercial use; commercial use is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

seat-limited.summary: Free in production up to a stated seat/device/user threshold, unlimited free non-production use; production use beyond the threshold is Paid Use at the Licensor's Published Price.

decentralized.summary: Free use with no Paid Use. Disputes go to exclusive online ICC arbitration, individual claims only, with each party's liability limited to US$1 in value, payable in money or the project's native token.
